notes: Official-source RAG seed for the Canada tourist Temporary Resident Visa product CA_TRV. This product does not include eTA, business visits, family-visit intake, study, work, Super Visa, transit, or permanent residence.

chunks.title: CA_TRV is the tourist visitor-visa product
chunks.content: CA_TRV is VIZA's Canada Temporary Resident Visa product for tourism. Tourism is fixed by package assignment and is not selected inside the applicant questionnaire. The product does not cover business visits, visits primarily to family or friends, transit, study, work, Super Visa, temporary resident permits, or permanent residence. These purposes require separate routing or products. Official source: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/visit-canada/apply-visitor-visa.html

chunks.title: Route visa and eTA eligibility before assigning CA_TRV
chunks.content: A Canadian electronic travel authorization (eTA) is a separate authorization with its own eligibility and application flow; it is not a CA_TRV option. VIZA must determine the required travel document before assigning a product by using the applicant's nationality, travel document, travel mode, current status, and any special IRCC eligibility. An eligible eTA traveller should eventually be routed to a separate CA_ETA product, not switched inside a started CA_TRV form. Use IRCC's current official routing tool as the authority: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/visit-canada/check-visa-eta.html

chunks.title: IRCC decides visa entry type and border admission
chunks.content: The applicant does not apply for a single-entry or multiple-entry TRV. IRCC decides which type of visitor visa to issue, and the application fee is the same. A visitor visa shows that the traveller met the requirements to travel to Canada but does not guarantee admission. A border services officer makes the final entry decision and normally authorizes a stay of up to six months unless a different departure date is recorded. Official source: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/application/application-forms-guides/guide-5256-applying-visitor-visa-temporary-resident-visa.html

chunks.title: Visitor-visa application channels and biometrics
chunks.content: IRCC normally requires visitor-visa applications online. Depending on eligibility and routing, the application may use the regular IRCC Portal, the limited new IRCC Portal, or an IRCC Secure Account. Portal credentials, invite codes, one-time passwords, and sessions are VIZA-managed operational data and must never be requested as applicant form answers. If IRCC issues a biometric instruction letter, the applicant must follow the stated instructions and deadline, normally through a visa application centre. Official sources: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/visit-canada/portal-application-process.html ; https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/application/online-account.html

documents.title: Canada Tourist TRV Form and Document Intake Requirements

chunks.title: IMM 5257 applicant-answer inventory
chunks.content: The CA_TRV answer schema reconstructs IMM 5257 for a tourism application. Collect UCI if known and service language; passport-exact family and given names; prior names; sex; date and place of birth; citizenship; current and previous residence status and dates; country and status where applying; current and former marriages or common-law relationships; language details; passport or travel-document details; Taiwan and Israeli passport questions when applicable; national identity document; United States permanent-resident details when applicable; mailing and residential addresses; telephone, fax, and email details; intended tourism dates, trip details, funds in Canadian dollars, and persons or institutions to visit; post-secondary education; and gap-free employment or activity history for the past ten years. The tourist purpose is fixed by CA_TRV and is not an applicant-facing purpose selector. Official source: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/application/application-forms-guides/guide-5256-applying-visitor-visa-temporary-resident-visa.html

chunks.title: IMM 5257 background questions remain separate
chunks.content: Collect separate answers and details for tuberculosis affecting the applicant, a family member, or a close contact within the applicable two-year period; a physical or mental condition that may require social or health services during the stay; unauthorized study or work or overstaying status in Canada; any visa or permit refusal, denied entry, or order to leave Canada or another country; prior applications to enter or remain in Canada; criminal acts, arrests, charges, or convictions; military, militia, civil-defence, security-organization, or police service with repeatable periods; association with a political, religious, violent, or criminal organization described by the form; and witnessing or participating in prisoner or civilian ill-treatment, looting, or religious desecration. Do not collapse these questions into a generic security question. Official source: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/application/application-forms-guides/guide-5256-applying-visitor-visa-temporary-resident-visa.html

chunks.title: Use the family form selected by the IRCC country package
chunks.content: Guide 5256 instructs an applicant to complete the Family Information form listed for the applicant's country package, either IMM 5707 or IMM 5645. The country-package audit performed for this seed on 2026-08-16 resolved to IMM 5707, so CA_TRV currently collects IMM 5707 details for the applicant, spouse or common-law/conjugal partner, both parents, and repeatable children including adopted and step-children. For each applicable person collect official/native-script names, date and country of birth, marital status, present address, occupation, and whether the person will accompany the applicant. Preserve the no-partner and no-children certifications and family declaration. Never merge IMM 5707 and IMM 5645; if a personalized checklist selects IMM 5645, route to a schema revision that also supports its sibling rows. Official sources: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/application/application-forms-guides/imm5707.html ; https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/application/application-forms-guides/imm5645.html

chunks.title: Chinese-citizen tourist applications require the IMM 0104 supplement
chunks.content: For a Chinese citizen applying under the current China tourist package, collect the IMM 0104 supplement conditionally. Employment history covers the past ten years or since age 18, whichever period is shorter, with no gaps; each row includes month/year dates, company or military/police unit name and address, position/title/rank, and duties, including military and police service since age 18. Education history includes every post-secondary institution with month/year dates, school name and address, diploma or degree, and course of study. Ask whether this is the first trip outside China; if not, collect travel for the past five years or since age 18, whichever period is shorter, including month/year dates, purpose, city, and country or territory. Official sources: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/application/application-forms-guides/imm0104.html ; https://ircc.canada.ca/english/information/applications/visa.asp?countrySelect=CN

chunks.title: The personalized IRCC checklist controls document requirements
chunks.content: Supporting evidence is document data, not a visa_form_fields answer. The personalized IRCC checklist and country package are authoritative. Depending on the applicant, evidence may include passport pages, legal status in the application country, travel history, itinerary and accommodation, financial and employment evidence, invitation and relationship evidence, minor travel authorization, certified translations, the selected family form, Schedule 1 IMM 5257, representative or information-release forms, and any requested photo. Do not present every possible document as universally mandatory. Official sources: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/application/application-forms-guides/imm5484.html ; https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/visit-canada/apply-visitor-visa.html

chunks.title: China tourist package has additional conditional documents
chunks.content: The current China visitor-visa package calls for country-specific evidence in addition to the general checklist. Depending on the applicant's circumstances, this can include Hukou and national identity evidence; bilingual IMM 0104; an employer leave letter, retirement certificate, or school enrolment and leave letter; financial history, social-insurance contribution records, individual income-tax certificates, and evidence of assets in China; previous travel evidence; travel-planning agent details; and a detailed itinerary. Military, government, or police history may trigger IMM 5546, IMM 0149, or IMM 0150 and related service documents. Treat these as conditional application_documents slots and re-check the current country package and personalized checklist before requesting them. Official sources: https://ircc.canada.ca/english/information/applications/visa.asp?countrySelect=CN ; https://ircc.canada.ca/english/pdf/kits/forms/IMM5884E.pdf

chunks.title: Passport and identity answers must follow the requested document field
chunks.content: Copy names, passport or travel-document number, date of birth, sex, citizenship, country of issue, issue date, and expiry date from the matching field on the applicant's valid document. Do not substitute issuing authority, place of issue, residence, pickup location, or destination when IMM 5257 asks for country or territory of issue. Given names may be left blank only if the travel document has no given name. Use the official form's closed-list option when one exists, and do not infer document facts from another answer. The applicant's document and current official field wording control whenever they are more specific than general guidance. Official source: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/application/application-forms-guides/guide-5256-applying-visitor-visa-temporary-resident-visa.html

chunks.title: Public-form reconstruction requires authenticated portal QA
chunks.content: The IMM 5257, current IMM 5707, and China IMM 0104 inventories have high confidence from public IRCC forms and guides. Exact authenticated portal page order, labels, selectors, value transforms, conditional personalized checklists, and portal variants remain live-portal-QA pending. State uncertainty rather than inventing a requirement, and defer to the current authenticated IRCC application and personalized checklist when they differ from this reconstruction. Portal credentials and sessions are not applicant answers. Official portal sources: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/visit-canada/portal-application-process.html ; https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/application/online-account.html
